name: Drowsiness Detection
description: On-device driver/operator drowsiness detection: 468-point FaceMesh landmarks drive eye-aspect-ratio (EAR) eye closure, PERCLOS and yawn (MAR) metrics to flag drowsy states. Publishes metrics over MQTT and streams H.264 via RTSP.
description_zh: 端侧驾驶员/操作员困倦检测：468 点 FaceMesh 关键点计算眼睛纵横比(EAR)闭眼、PERCLOS 与打哈欠(MAR)指标，判定困倦状态。通过 MQTT 发布指标，并以 RTSP 推送 H.264 视频。
author: Seeed Studio
